contact.evidence_quote: Brian Kynoch ... Mr. Kynoch is President of Imperial Metals and has been with the Company since 1995 and a director since 2002. He has been involved in exploration, permitting, development, commissioning, operation and reclamation of numerous mines and mineral properties including Red Chris, Mount Polley, Huckleberry, Sterling, Nickel Plate, Goldstream and Castle Mountain mines. Mr. Kynoch is a Civil Engineer and a member of Engineers and Geoscientists BC and Canadian Institute of Mining Metallurgy and Petroleum
